questions.questionText:
Which of the following sentences uses a modal verb to show possibility? 
Read the passage and answer the following question: 
The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 is among the most important education reforms introduced in India in 
recent years. It seeks to improve the education system by making it more holistic, flexible, multidisciplinary, and 
better suited to the demands of the 21st century. To achieve this, the policy replaces the 10+2 pattern with a 5+3+3+4 
structure, giving special importance to the foundational stage and promoting critical thinking from an early age. 
A major feature of the NEP is its focus on using the mother tongue or regional language as the medium of instruction 
at the primary level. This has drawn both support and concern. Many experts feel it can strengthen children’s roots 
and understanding, while others worry about practical challenges in implementation and possible effects on English 
language proficiency. 
In addition, the NEP encourages vocational education, digital literacy, and interdisciplinary studies. It aims to move 
away from rote learning and an exam-centred approach by promoting practical knowledge and creativity. If carried 
out effectively, the NEP could significantly reshape India’s educational landscape for future generations.
options: The policy introduces a new 5+3+3+4 structure in place of the 10+2 system.
It seeks to reduce rote learning and an exam-centred approach.
Experts believe it will strengthen children’s roots and understanding.
If implemented well, the NEP could transform India’s educational landscape.
